ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the workload, measured metrics and the no-guess flag are declared; it does not show a profile was actually taken.
offer: Profile a representative workload and name the measured resource costs. Do not optimize from intuition when a repeatable measurement can establish the bottleneck.

minimal.reason: Name the representative workload that was profiled. A profile of an unspecified run cannot be repeated, so describe the input and environment.

mid.reason: List the measured resource costs, such as CPU time or memory. Without numbers the bottleneck is a guess, so record the metrics.

maximal.reason: Set optimizing without measurement to false. Optimizing from intuition wastes effort and can regress other paths, so measure first.

rule.reason: Name the representative workload that was profiled. A profile of an unspecified run cannot be repeated, so describe the input and environment.
